title: Red Folk Bodice with a Stork
prompt: An original young woman with copper-red hair in a loose braid and pale blue eyes stands in a wheat field beside a white stork with wings half-open. She wears a red and cream embroidered bodice with layered pearl and beaded necklaces, a tan linen blouse with gathered puff sleeves, and a striped red skirt. A woven basket sits at her side. Her expression is steady and direct. Soft, late-afternoon sun under a blue sky. Warm palette of wheat gold, cream, and crimson. Rustic and cinematic, in the style of a pastoral fashion editorial.
workingNotes:
- The stork and wheat field set the story; keep them in the frame.
- Use 'wide shot' to show more of the landscape.
